title.en: Velocity field,shear rate and Newton’s viscosity law
title.gu: Velocity Field,Shear Rate અને Newton નો Viscosity Law

h.en: Velocity field,shear rate and Newton’s viscosity law
h.gu: Velocity Field,Shear Rate અને Newton નો Viscosity Law

body.en:
Definition and principle

A velocity field specifies the fluid velocity vector at each position and time. A velocity gradient is the spatial change of velocity. For simple parallel shear, the relevant gradient is the tangential velocity change normal to neighbouring layers. Shear stress is tangential force per area; shear rate has units s⁻¹.

Important points

For a Newtonian fluid, shear stress is proportional to shear rate at fixed temperature/pressure. Dynamic viscosity μ is the proportionality factor, with units Pa s. Kinematic viscosity ν is μ divided by density, with units m² s⁻¹.The signs depend on the chosen stress component; use magnitudes for a simple positive viscosity calculation. Do not confuse shear rate with bulk flow rate.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા અને સિદ્ધાંત

દરેક position તથા time પર velocity vector દર્શાવતું વર્ણન Velocity Field છે.Velocity માં spatial change ને Velocity Gradient કહે છે.Simple parallel shear માં neighbouring layers ને normal direction માં tangential velocity નો change લેવાય છે.Shear Stress એકમ area દીઠ tangential force છે; Shear Rate નો એકમ s⁻¹ છે.

મહત્વના મુદ્દા

Newtonian fluid માટે fixed temperature/pressure પર shear stress, shear rate ને સમપ્રમાણ છે.Dynamic Viscosity μ proportionality factor છે; એકમ Pa s. Kinematic Viscosity ν એટલે μ ને density થી ભાગતાં મળતું value; એકમ m² s⁻¹.Stress component ની convention પ્રમાણે sign બદલાય છે.Simple viscosity calculation માં magnitudes લો.Shear rate તથા bulk flow rate જુદા છે.

title.en: Boundary-layer formation in a straight tube
title.gu: Straight Tube માં Boundary Layer ની રચના

h.en: Boundary-layer formation in a straight tube
h.gu: Straight Tube માં Boundary Layer ની રચના

body.en:
Definition and principle

A boundary layer is the near-wall region where viscous effects produce an appreciable velocity gradient. A fluid entering a tube with an approximately uniform profile satisfies no-slip at the wall, so wall-adjacent fluid slows and boundary layers grow inward.

Important points

In the entrance region, the axial velocity profile changes with distance. When the layers reach the centre and the profile shape no longer changes downstream, the flow is hydrodynamically fully developed. This does not mean velocity is uniform across the section: laminar flow has a parabolic profile. Turbulent profiles are flatter in the core but still satisfy the wall condition. Entrance losses/development must be considered before using fully developed pipe equations.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા અને સિદ્ધાંત

Wall નજીક viscous effects થી નોંધપાત્ર velocity gradient હોય તે region Boundary Layer છે.Approximately uniform profile સાથે tube માં પ્રવેશતા fluid માટે wall પર no-slip condition લાગુ પડે છે.Wall પાસે fluid ધીમો થાય છે અને boundary layers અંદર તરફ વધે છે.

મહત્વના મુદ્દા

Entrance region માં axial velocity profile distance સાથે બદલાય છે.Layers centre સુધી પહોંચે અને downstream profile shape ન બદલાય ત્યારે Hydrodynamically Fully Developed Flow કહેવાય છે.તેનો અર્થ section માં uniform velocity નથી.Laminar profile parabolic છે.Turbulent profile core માં flatter હોય છે, પણ wall condition લાગુ રહે છે.Fully developed equations પહેલાં entrance effects ધ્યાનમાં લો.

body.en:
Definition and principle

A Newtonian fluid has a linear shear-stress/shear-rate relation through the origin, with viscosity independent of shear rate at fixed conditions. A non-Newtonian fluid does not obey that simple constant-viscosity relation.

Important points

Shear-thinning fluids have decreasing apparent viscosity as shear rate rises; many polymer solutions behave this way. Shear-thickening suspensions can show the opposite trend. Bingham-type fluids require a yield stress before sustained flow; time-dependent thixotropic behaviour is another distinct feature. Examples depend on formulation/conditions, not merely a product name. A non-Newtonian fluid is not automatically compressible or turbulent.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા અને સિદ્ધાંત

Fixed conditions પર origin માંથી પસાર થતો linear shear-stress/shear-rate સંબંધ તથા shear rate થી independent viscosity ધરાવતો fluid Newtonian છે.Constant-viscosity નો આ સરળ સંબંધ ન પાળતો fluid Non-Newtonian છે.

મહત્વના મુદ્દા

Shear-thinning fluid માં shear rate વધતાં apparent viscosity ઘટે છે; ઘણા polymer solutions આવું વર્તે છે.Shear-thickening suspensions માં વિરુદ્ધ trend હોઈ શકે છે.Bingham-type fluid માં sustained flow પહેલાં yield stress જોઈએ.Time-dependent thixotropy અલગ feature છે.Examples formulation/conditions પ્રમાણે બદલાય છે.ફક્ત product name પરથી behaviour નક્કી ન કરો.Non-Newtonian એટલે compressible અથવા turbulent નહીં.

સમીકરણો / સંકેતો

body.en:
Definition

Reynolds experiment demonstrates laminar, transitional and turbulent tube flow.

Construction

A constant-head reservoir supplies a transparent straight tube through a smooth inlet. A fine dye injector introduces a filament near the axis. A control valve sets the water flow and a measuring tank/flowmeter provides discharge. The dye stream must not itself disturb the flow.

Working and applications

At low flow the dye remains a narrow line, indicating laminar motion. As flow rises it becomes unstable in transition and then mixes across a turbulent stream. Re is inertial effects divided by viscous effects. For a circular pipe, Re below about 2300 is ordinarily laminar and above about 4000 ordinarily turbulent; the intermediate range is transitional. These are approximate criteria affected by disturbances, not universal thresholds for every geometry.

Governing relation
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Laminar, transitional તથા turbulent tube flow દર્શાવતો અભ્યાસ Reynolds Experiment છે.

રચના (Construction)

Constant-head reservoir માંથી smooth inlet મારફતે transparent straight tube માં flow આવે છે.Fine dye injector axis નજીક filament આપે છે.Control valve flow નક્કી કરે છે.Measuring tank/flowmeter થી discharge મળે છે.Dye stream પોતે flow disturb ન કરવો જોઈએ.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ અને ઉપયોગો

ઓછા flow પર dye narrow line તરીકે રહે છે, જે laminar motion બતાવે છે.Flow વધતાં transition માં line unstable અને turbulent stream માં cross-section માં mix થાય છે.Re inertial તથા viscous effects નો ગુણોત્તર છે.Circular pipe માટે આશરે 2300 કરતાં ઓછું Re laminar અને 4000 કરતાં વધુ turbulent ગણાય છે.વચ્ચે transitional range છે.આ approximate criteria છે; દરેક geometry માટે universal thresholds નથી.

મૂળ સંબંધ

h.gu: 3. Reynolds Apparatus થી Flow ની ઓળખ

body.en:
Aim and principle

Observe dye behaviour and calculate Re from genuine flow, diameter and fluid-property data.

Apparatus and connections

Constant-head tank, transparent tube, dye injector, control valve, collection vessel/time or calibrated flowmeter and thermometer.

Supervised procedure

Level and prime the rig as specified. Inject a fine minimally disturbing dye filament. Increase flow only within the SOP; record each observed pattern, temperature and discharge. Calculate Re and compare with approximate circular-pipe ranges.

Blank observations—actual work required

Calculation

Result

Actual result:____; units:____; repeats/uncertainty:____; apparatus/SOP:____.No experiment has been performed for these notes.

Precautions and safe fault-finding

Avoid excessive dye flow, air bubbles and inlet disturbance. Never fabricate exact transition thresholds from an unobserved run.

Genuine flow, diameter તથા fluid properties પરથી Re કાઢો અને dye behaviour observe કરો.

Constant-head tank, transparent tube, dye injector, control valve, collection vessel/time અથવા calibrated flowmeter તથા thermometer.

Task, report and evidence

Record only genuine permitted photos, readings and presentation evidence.
